verdict.rationale: Gitea has no documented sandbox or test-mode feature. The evidence points only to workarounds: a public 'Try Gitea' instance a user tested against (gitea-comm-12), and an easy single-binary, SQLite-capable self-hosted deployment (gitea-docs-9, gitea-docs-14, gitea-comm-1), which would let you spin up a separate throwaway instance isolated from production. Missing for 10: a documented first-party sandbox/test environment, guidance on isolating test data from production, agent-oriented sandbox workflows, and hands-on corroboration of sandbox use for API/agent testing.
